authorization: Only the already-authorized held PUT gate may consume/preserve bounded signed body bytes before arrived/cancellation wait. No source, binding, assertion, credential, request-permission or timeout changes.

delta.maximumSource: existing native collector maximum response/record byte bound; no existing request/operation timeout changed

mechanism: Consume the accepted body through EOF within the existing 32 MiB native maximum, reject read/size failures explicitly, restore the exact body stream, then signal arrived and use the same cancellation/release gate. The existing capability checks remain before body access.
